title: Exact-coordinate block preservation as a declared correspondence sensitivity constraint
question: Within the already frozen rpc two-block domains, can the existing reviewed relation coexist with preserving each baseline-coassigned block of exactly identical full point-pair coordinates, and how does that change feasible membership, support, edit count and relation changes?
prior_exposure: Full upstream report, code, human review and summary read. 5-degree baseline aided counts/ranges and split-identical-coordinates finding already known. This is development sensitivity analysis, not preregistration of the source study or held-out evaluation.
equality_definition: Within each of the two old groups independently, group observations by exact equality of all four stored coordinate scalars. Preserve coassignment only for buckets of size >=2. No merging across old groups, no metric-distance tolerance, no deduplication, no identity or semantic inference.
four_conditions: same constraints plus existing human relation
same constraints plus human relation plus equality preservation
human_scope: Read exact rpc ids and processed indices from source human_review. Existing same-corner triple and rejected-purple relation only. If any triple member outside domain report incomplete; rejected point outside already separated by fixed outside membership.
implementation: Independent spherical unit-vector angles and parity union-find. Compare exact canonical assignment sets against upstream saved ledgers under all four filters. Direct brute-force all 2^17 canonical assignments in 18-node 5-degree pair domain independently.
outputs: minimum edit then original W results with all 1e-10 ties
complete moved/added/lost relation lists for selected candidates
feasible masks and original source ids
stopping_condition: Finish all 30 domains, independent comparisons and direct 18-node check. Explicitly record inconsistency, budget excess or incomplete human scope without relaxing constraints. No new thresholds, objectives, domains or claim of semantic success.
prohibitions: No new semantic labels or propagation
No global layout or general effectiveness claim

additional_outputs_before_calculation.parent_request: Count target-support >=12 and >12 of 24; coordinate-median target-center extrema if unambiguous circular unwrapping is certifiable within fixed domain. Counts are combinatorial, not probabilities; extrema conditional, not confidence intervals.
